description: Conclusion: best estimate of the highest measured GRWT100 in the candidate set
observation: Among all 20 candidates with E1 predicted GRWT100 > 3.17 (all of which were measured via the oracle), the highest measured value is 5.0 g for IRIS_313.12254 (also the model rank-1 predicted). Second: IRIS_313.12349 = 4.7. Third: IRIS_313.12344 = 4.6. All 884 unqueried candidates have predicted <= 3.171 and, under the empirical top-20 calibration (residual sd ~0.45-0.6), would need a >4 SD positive residual to exceed 5.0. Estimated probability of a missed higher-measured unqueried line is small (~0.3-7% under realistic noise; higher only under a pessimistic flat-slope model that the observed data contradict). LIMITATIONS: single environment; hidden measured values only partly sampled (20/904); no proof of global argmax; E3 measurements are the stored historical phenotypes.
